description: Renovate keeps the GitHub Actions used by the workflows up to date and pinned to commit SHAs. Image digests, Wolfi packages and other build pins in docker-bake.hcl are updated by .github/scripts/update_dependencies.py (Daily Dependency Update), which knows which pins belong to FIPS-validated modules and must never change.

packageRules.description: Major versions change behaviour: review them by hand
Python, Node.js and runner image versions used by the workflows change the CI environment itself: open the PR, but merge it by hand
Minor, patch and digest updates merge on their own after a 4-day stability period, once every check on the PR has passed

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule and the stability period, and still merge only after checks pass
